**Review of the search ad**

- **"Plastic-Free Tea Bags"** (headline): Supported. The brand policy says tea bags are plastic-free.
- **"Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable."**: Supported. Both claims are on the allowlist.
- **"Best tea I've ever had" - Emma, Leeds**: Not supported. The policy lists no customer quotes, and nothing shows that Emma is a real customer who agreed to be quoted. A named testimonial with a location presents itself as a real review, so it needs a verified source and permission before it runs. If it can't be sourced, remove it. The "best" wording is also a superlative, but because it is a personal opinion, the main problem is that the attribution is unverified.

**Recommendation:** Do not publish as is. Either remove the quote or confirm it comes from a real, consented customer review. The rest of the copy can stay. A safe version is:

Headline: Plastic-Free Tea Bags | Description: Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "\"Best tea I've ever had\" - Emma, Leeds.", "type": "fake_testimonial"}], "publish": false}
```
